shortDescription: The CAC 40 Index fell 33 points or 0.39 percent on Tuesday to close at 8302 points.Leading the losses are Stellantis NV (-3.13%), STMicroelectronics (-2.82%) and Pernod Ricard (-2.71%).Top gainers were TotalEnergies SE (2.81%), Air Liquide (2.15%) and Carrefour (2.07%).
